detail.longDescription: GitHub has unveiled Project HydraFusion, a research preview for Copilot CLI that treats workflow selection as an optimisation problem. Instead of routing prompts to a single model, it builds execution plans per request, choosing between single model, cascade with quality gate, or critique patterns. Early benchmarks show up to 67% lower cost versus Opus 5. https://www. marktechpost.com/2026/09/05/gi thub-introduces-project-hydrafusion-runtime-multi-model-orchestration-that-builds-a-workflow-per-coding-task-in-copilot-cli/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AgenticAI
